races.name: Rimeling
races.desc: Small, frosty and calm. Fires simply go out around them.

weapons.name: Frost Repeater
weapons.desc: Two icy bolts. A hit freezes the target's thrusters for a moment.

weapons.name: Icicle Launcher
weapons.desc: A missile of solid ice that shatters into the next room.

weapons.name: Deep Chiller
weapons.desc: Ion frost that leaves a system sluggish for a while.

drones.name: Snowplough Drone
drones.desc: Ploughs incoming missiles and loose rocks out of the way.

augments.name: Cold Sink
augments.desc: Weapons charge 18% faster, but the cold makes crew repair 15% slower.

goods.name: Glacier wine
goods.desc: Fermented inside a comet. Served very cold.

quirks.name: Stoic
quirks.desc: Has never once complained about the cold. Or anything.

arms.name: Ice Pick
arms.desc: A climber's pick. Surprisingly good in a corridor fight.

ships.name: The Sledge
ships.desc: Slow, sturdy and very warm inside.

sectors.name: The Glacier Belt
sectors.blurb: Frozen comets, frozen wrecks, and pirates who wear three coats.
intro: Everything out here is cold, slow and patient.

events.text: "Ice toll. Ten scrap, or we cut your engines out and keep them as a souvenir."

effect.text: They wave you through, grinning.

choices.text: Have {who} explain the toll is illegal.

effect.text: {who} quotes three regulations. They leave out of sheer boredom.
So be it.

events.text: "You're a long way from anywhere warm, little ship."

effect.text: Weapons hot. Very hot.

choices.text: Offer a bottle of glacier wine.

effect.text: They drink to your health and leave you alone.

events.title: Frozen derelict
events.text: A freighter hangs in the dark, iced over from nose to tail. Something inside is still blinking.

choices.text: Strip the hull plating and go.

effect.text: Cold work, but honest. The plating sells.

success.text: Crates of glacier wine, perfectly chilled.

fail.text: The hold was holding back a lot of very cold air. {crew} gets frostbite.

effect.text: {who} glows red and the ice slides off. Inside: a spare drone and a thank-you note.
Some wrecks are better left frozen.

events.text: An old ice miner sells you a chart with one beacon circled twice.

effect.text: "Don't wake the big one," he says.
He shrugs and goes back to his soup.

events.title: The circled beacon
events.text: A cache in the ice, and an icebreaker drone parked on top of it.

effect.text: The drone wakes up.
Not today.

events.text: A shivering kid is hiding in your cargo bay, wrapped in three of your blankets.

choices.text: Let her stay till the next port.

effect.text: She eats everything and fixes the toaster.

choices.text: Hand her to the port authority.

effect.text: She doesn't look back.

events.title: A message
events.text: A message from the kid: her family runs a shipyard, and they want to say thank you.

effect.text: They patch your hull and won't take a penny.

events.text: A distress call from inside a comet.

effect.text: Nothing but ice.

events.text: A distress call from inside a comet. A voice, faint: "Please. We're nearly out of air."

effect.text: A Rimeling miner tumbles out, gasping and grateful, and asks to join.
You log the location and move on.

events.text: A distress call from inside a comet. A voice, faint: "Please. We're nearly out of air."

effect.text: The comet splits open. It was a pirate hide all along.

afterWin.text: Their stash is full of picks and wine.

effect.text: Later you hear they found a pirate nest there. A small reward arrives.

events.text: A frozen outpost. The settlers haven't had a hot meal in a month.

choices.text: Share a meal from the hold.

effect.text: They've never tasted anything so good. They load you up with fuel.

choices.text: Trade for their spare cells (20 scrap).

effect.text: Fair trade. Cold hands, warm hearts.
They wave until you're out of sight.
